newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli planes strike in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli planes strike in south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli planes raided suspected guerrilla targets in the south Lebanon highlands on Wednesday, security sources said.
The sources said the air raid targeted Iqlim al-Toufah ridge used by pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas to wage attacks on Israeli forces occupying a border zone to the south.
There was no immediate word on casualties.

Hizbollah (Party of God) is fighting to oust some 1,000 Israeli troops and the 3,000-strong allied South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia holding the south Lebanon zone set up by Israel in 1985 to protect its northern border area from guerrilla raids.
